incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A multi-story brick building with significant structural damage and debris at its base, surrounded by construction barriers and traffic cones. In the background, modern high-rise buildings are visible under a partly cloudy sky.

observations.description: A red brick building with collapsed upper floors, exposed wooden framing, and shattered windows.
A traffic light pole with multiple lights on a damaged street corner, alongside a traffic cone and debris pile.
An orange cone and a green awning tarp lying on the ground next to a pile of bricks and wood.
A white vehicle (possibly a truck) is visible on the street in the distance.
